title: GTA 6 made HOW much on day one?! 🤯 #gta6 #shorts
description: GTA 6's preorders + first-day sales hit $3.79 billion, per Take-Two. Here's how that stacks up against GTA V and GTA IV. Sources: Take-Two via Variety; GTA V/IV day-one figures as widely reported.

scenes.say: GTA 6 just made three point seven nine billion dollars.
That's preorders plus first-day sales, according to Take-Two.

scenes.title: Day-one sales
scenes.say: GTA 5 did about eight hundred fifteen million on day one. GTA 4? Three hundred ten million.

scenes.label: GTA V's launch
scenes.say: So GTA 6 beat GTA 5's launch by more than four and a half times.
Take-Two is calling it the biggest entertainment launch in history. Not just games. Anything.

scenes.text: Did you buy it day one?
scenes.say: So be honest. Did you buy it day one?
